purpose: Use separate enterprise-facing and connected-operations inbox roles while preserving one human principal, protected credentials, deduplication, and provider readback.

responsibilities: receive GitHub Enterprise confirmations and receipts

stackingRules: Both inbox roles belong to the same JP-controlled mission but remain distinct provider identities.
Forward or relay ordinary provider confirmations when connector readback requires it.
Never forward passwords, passkeys, MFA codes, CAPTCHA answers, recovery codes, payment-card data, identity documents, private keys, or encrypted-note keys.
A forwarded message does not replace the provider-original message; preserve both records.
Deduplicate by provider message identity, subject, timestamp, enterprise slug, and confirmation reference before acting.
User-reported signup is recorded separately from email readback and authenticated provider readback.
No duplicate signup or blind retry is allowed while provider outcome is reported or unknown.
Consequential account, legal, identity, payment, billing, or recovery steps remain JP-only.
